name: Sanctuary on Camelback Mountain
positioning: Desert resort on 53 acres on Camelback Mountain in Paradise Valley, with casitas, suites, private villas and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a casita or suite with mountain or landscape views
Groups or families wanting a private mountainside villa with its own pool

facts.text: Sanctuary is a Paradise Valley resort set on 53 acres of desert on Camelback Mountain.
The resort has manicured grounds, gardens and pools.
The Mountain Casitas are set against the backdrop of Paradise Valley, with contemporary architecture and views.
The multi-level Spa Patio Casitas have an outdoor patio with landscape views.
Casitas in the Villa del Sol enclave each have a king bedroom and a full bathroom with an indoor soaking tub and a private outdoor shower.
Suites come in one- and two-bedroom options.
Villa Norte has a spacious adobe-style design and southwestern decor.
Sanctuary Spa's menu ranges from age-defying facials to desert-inspired body treatments.
Sanctuary offers private, interactive 90-minute mixology classes.
Jade Bar serves a la carte hand-rolled sushi and nigiri prepared fresh to order by the resort's sushi chef.
Elements restaurant has sweeping views of the surrounding mountains.
There are casita and suite options for mobility-accessible guests.

highlights.text: One private villa offers 270 degrees of views, two master bedrooms, a pool, an expansive patio with an infinity-edge hot tub and a separate guest house.
The private villas are on the mountainside, each with spacious accommodations and personalized amenities, suited to watching sunrises and sunsets across Camelback Mountain.
The Sanctuary Spa Suites have a spacious layout and an outdoor soaking tub.
One villa is a private enclave with its own spa treatment room, a movement studio, a lawn and a private pool with a wrap-around patio.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded mountain location means transportation is needed to reach nearby attractions.
Area experiences such as sunrise hot air balloon rides over the Sonoran Desert and tours of Frank Lloyd Wright's Taliesin West are off-site; guests can contact the Concierge to plan them.
